from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone
from common.exceptions import BusinessRuleViolation
from .models import Review, ReviewHelpful


def create_review(*, user, book, rating, title, comment):
    """ساخت نظر جدید."""
    if Review.objects.filter(user=user, book=book).exists():
        raise BusinessRuleViolation("شما قبلاً برای این کتاب نظر داده‌اید.")

    with transaction.atomic():
        review = Review.objects.create(
            user=user, book=book,
            rating=rating, title=title, comment=comment,
        )
        # آمار پروفایل
        profile = getattr(user, "profile", None)
        if profile:
            profile.total_reviews = (profile.total_reviews or 0) + 1
            profile.save(update_fields=["total_reviews"])

    return review


def approve_review(*, review, approver):
    """تأیید نظر."""
    if not approver.is_staff:
        raise BusinessRuleViolation("فقط کارمندان می‌توانند نظر تأیید کنند.")
    review.is_approved = True
    review.approved_at = timezone.now()
    review.approved_by = approver
    review.save(update_fields=["is_approved", "approved_at", "approved_by"])

    # اعلان به کاربر
    from notifications.services import send_notification
    send_notification(
        user=review.user,
        type="review_approved",
        title="نظر شما تأیید شد",
        message=f"نظر شما روی کتاب «{review.book.title}» تأیید شد.",
    )
    return review


def mark_helpful(*, review, user):
    """رأی مفید بود."""
    _, created = ReviewHelpful.objects.get_or_create(review=review, user=user)
    if not created:
        raise BusinessRuleViolation("شما قبلاً این نظر را مفید علامت‌گذاری کرده‌اید.")

    from django.db.models import F
    Review.objects.filter(pk=review.pk).update(helpful_count=F("helpful_count") + 1)
    review.refresh_from_db()
    return review

from rest_framework import viewsets, mixins
from rest_framework.decorators import action
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated, IsAuthenticatedOrReadOnly
from rest_framework.response import Response

from common.permissions import IsOwnerOrReadOnly
from .models import Review
from .serializers import ReviewSerializer, ReviewApprovalSerializer
from .services import create_review, mark_helpful


class ReviewViewSet(
    mixins.ListModelMixin,
    mixins.CreateModelMixin,
    mixins.RetrieveModelMixin,
    mixins.UpdateModelMixin,
    mixins.DestroyModelMixin,
    viewsets.GenericViewSet,
):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticatedOrReadOnly, IsOwnerOrReadOnly]

    def get_queryset(self):
        qs = Review.objects.select_related("user", "book").filter(is_approved=True)
        book_id = self.kwargs.get("book_pk")
        if book_id:
            qs = qs.filter(book_id=book_id)
        return qs

    def get_serializer_class(self):
        if self.action == "approve":
            return ReviewApprovalSerializer
        return ReviewSerializer

    def perform_create(self, serializer):
        book_id = self.kwargs.get("book_pk") or self.request.data.get("book")
        from catalog.models import Book
        book = Book.objects.get(pk=book_id)
        review = create_review(
            user=self.request.user,
            book=book,
            rating=serializer.validated_data["rating"],
            title=serializer.validated_data.get("title", ""),
            comment=serializer.validated_data["comment"],
        )
        serializer.instance = review

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"], permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated])
    def helpful(self, request, pk=None):
        review = self.get_object()
        review = mark_helpful(review=review, user=request.user)
        return Response({"helpful_count": review.helpful_count})

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"], permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated])
    def approve(self, request, pk=None):
        from .services import approve_review
        review = self.get_object()
        review = approve_review(review=review, approver=request.user)
        return Response(ReviewSerializer(review).data)

from datetime import timedelta
from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone
from common.exceptions import BusinessRuleViolation, ResourceConflict
from .models import Loan, Reservation


MAX_ACTIVE_LOANS = 5


def create_loan(*, user, book):
    """ساخت امانت جدید."""
    if book.stock <= 0:
        raise ResourceConflict("این کتاب موجود نیست. می‌توانید رزرو کنید.")

    active_loans = Loan.objects.filter(user=user, status="active").count()
    if active_loans >= MAX_ACTIVE_LOANS:
        raise BusinessRuleViolation(f"حداکثر {MAX_ACTIVE_LOANS} امانت فعال مجاز است.")

    if Loan.objects.filter(user=user, book=book, status="active").exists():
        raise BusinessRuleViolation("شما این کتاب را در امانت دارید.")

    with transaction.atomic():
        from catalog.models import Book
        Book.objects.filter(pk=book.pk).update(
            stock=models.F("stock") - 1,
            loans_count=models.F("loans_count") + 1,
        )
        loan = Loan.objects.create(
            user=user, book=book,
            status="active",
            borrowed_at=timezone.now(),
            due_date=timezone.now() + timedelta(days=Loan.LOAN_DURATION_DAYS),
        )

    # اعلان
    from notifications.services import send_notification
    send_notification(
        user=user,
        type="loan_created",
        title="امانت ثبت شد",
        message=f"کتاب «{book.title}» تا {loan.due_date.date()} در امانت شماست.",
        payload={"loan_id": str(loan.id), "book_id": str(book.id)},
    )
    return loan


def return_loan(*, loan, handler=None):
    """بازگشت امانت."""
    if loan.status not in ("active", "overdue"):
        raise BusinessRuleViolation("این امانت در وضعیت قابل بازگشت نیست.")

    with transaction.atomic():
        from catalog.models import Book
        from django.db.models import F
        Book.objects.filter(pk=loan.book_id).update(stock=F("stock") + 1)
        loan.status = "returned"
        loan.returned_at = timezone.now()
        loan.handled_by = handler
        loan.save(update_fields=["status", "returned_at", "handled_by"])

    return loan


def extend_loan(*, loan):
    """تمدید امانت."""
    if not loan.can_extend:
        raise BusinessRuleViolation("این امانت قابل تمدید نیست.")

    loan.due_date = loan.due_date + timedelta(days=7)
    loan.extended_count += 1
    loan.save(update_fields=["due_date", "extended_count"])
    return loan


def create_reservation(*, user, book):
    """رزرو کتابی که موجود نیست."""
    if book.stock > 0:
        raise BusinessRuleViolation("این کتاب موجود است، می‌توانید امانت بگیرید.")

    if Reservation.objects.filter(user=user, book=book, status__in=["waiting", "ready"]).exists():
        raise BusinessRuleViolation("شما قبلاً این کتاب را رزرو کرده‌اید.")

    # موقعیت در صف
    last = Reservation.objects.filter(book=book, status="waiting").order_by("-position").first()
    position = (last.position + 1) if last else 1

    reservation = Reservation.objects.create(
        user=user, book=book,
        status="waiting", position=position,
    )
    return reservation


def notify_reservation_ready(*, reservation):
    """کتاب بازگشت داده شده، نفر اول صف مطلع شود."""
    reservation.status = "ready"
    reservation.notified_at = timezone.now()
    reservation.expires_at = timezone.now() + timedelta(days=Reservation.RESERVATION_HOLD_DAYS)
    reservation.save(update_fields=["status", "notified_at", "expires_at"])

    from notifications.services import send_notification
    send_notification(
        user=reservation.user,
        type="reservation_ready",
        title="رزرو شما آماده است",
        message=f"کتاب «{reservation.book.title}» برای شما آماده است. تا {reservation.expires_at.date()} فرصت دارید.",
    )
    return reservation

from celery import shared_task
from django.utils import timezone
from .models import Loan, Reservation


@shared_task
def check_overdue_loans():
    """بررسی امانت‌های دیرکرد."""
    from datetime import timedelta
    now = timezone.now()
    threshold = now - timedelta(days=1)

    overdue_loans = Loan.objects.filter(
        status="active",
        due_date__lt=now,
    )

    count = overdue_loans.count()
    for loan in overdue_loans:
        loan.status = "overdue"
        loan.save(update_fields=["status"])

        from notifications.services import send_notification
        send_notification(
            user=loan.user,
            type="loan_overdue",
            title="کتاب شما دیرکرد دارد",
            message=f"کتاب «{loan.book.title}» باید تا {loan.due_date.date()} بازگردانده می‌شد.",
            priority="high",
        )
    return count


@shared_task
def send_due_reminders():
    """یادآوری ۳ روز قبل از موعد."""
    from datetime import timedelta
    now = timezone.now()
    target = now + timedelta(days=3)

    loans = Loan.objects.filter(
        status="active",
        due_date__date=target.date(),
    ).select_related("user", "book")

    from notifications.services import send_notification
    for loan in loans:
        send_notification(
            user=loan.user,
            type="loan_due_soon",
            title="یادآوری بازگشت کتاب",
            message=f"کتاب «{loan.book.title}» تا {loan.due_date.date()} فرصت دارد.",
        )
    return loans.count()


@shared_task
def cleanup_expired_reservations():
    """پاکسازی رزروهای منقضی."""
    now = timezone.now()
    expired = Reservation.objects.filter(
        status="ready",
        expires_at__lt=now,
    )

    for res in expired:
        res.status = "expired"
        res.save(update_fields=["status"])

        # نفر بعدی صف
        next_res = Reservation.objects.filter(
            book=res.book, status="waiting"
        ).order_by("position").first()
        if next_res:
            from .services import notify_reservation_ready
            notify_reservation_ready(reservation=next_res)

    return expired.count()

from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
import secrets
from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone
from common.exceptions import BusinessRuleViolation
from .models import Subscription, Payment


SUBSCRIPTION_PRICES = {
    "basic": Decimal("100000"),   # ۱۰۰ هزار تومان ماهانه
    "pro": Decimal("300000"),     # ۳۰۰ هزار تومان ماهانه
}


@transaction.atomic
def initiate_payment(*, user, tier, gateway):
    """شروع فرآیند پرداخت."""
    if tier not in SUBSCRIPTION_PRICES:
        raise BusinessRuleViolation("پلن انتخاب‌شده نامعتبر است.")

    amount = SUBSCRIPTION_PRICES[tier]
    payment = Payment.objects.create(
        user=user,
        amount=amount,
        currency="IRR",
        gateway=gateway,
        status="pending",
        gateway_authority=secrets.token_urlsafe(32),
    )
    return payment, f"https://gateway.example.com/pay/{payment.gateway_authority}"


@transaction.atomic
def verify_payment(*, payment, gateway_response):
    """تأیید پرداخت و فعال‌سازی اشتراک."""
    if payment.status != "pending":
        raise BusinessRuleViolation("این پرداخت قابل تأیید نیست.")

    success = gateway_response.get("status") == "success"
    payment.gateway_response = gateway_response
    payment.transaction_id = gateway_response.get("transaction_id", "")

    if success:
        payment.status = "success"
        payment.paid_at = timezone.now()
        payment.save()

        # فعال‌سازی اشتراک
        tier = _detect_tier(payment.amount)
        subscription = Subscription.objects.create(
            user=payment.user,
            tier=tier,
            status="active",
            started_at=timezone.now(),
            expires_at=timezone.now() + timedelta(days=30),
        )
        payment.subscription = subscription
        payment.save(update_fields=["subscription"])

        # به‌روزرسانی پروفایل
        profile = getattr(payment.user, "profile", None)
        if profile:
            profile.subscription_tier = tier
            profile.subscription_started = subscription.started_at
            profile.subscription_expires = subscription.expires_at
            profile.save(update_fields=["subscription_tier", "subscription_started", "subscription_expires"])

        # اعلان
        from notifications.services import send_notification
        send_notification(
            user=payment.user,
            type="payment_success",
            title="پرداخت موفق",
            message=f"اشتراک {tier} شما فعال شد.",
        )
    else:
        payment.status = "failed"
        payment.save()

        from notifications.services import send_notification
        send_notification(
            user=payment.user,
            type="payment_failed",
            title="پرداخت ناموفق",
            message="پرداخت شما انجام نشد. لطفاً دوباره تلاش کنید.",
        )

    return payment


def _detect_tier(amount):
    for tier, price in SUBSCRIPTION_PRICES.items():
        if price == amount:
            return tier
    return "basic"

import pytest
from datetime import date
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

from catalog.models import Author, Category, Book
from loans.models import Loan

User = get_user_model()


@pytest.mark.django_db
@pytest.mark.integration
def test_full_user_flow():
    """جریان کامل: ثبت‌نام → ساخت کتاب → امانت → بازگشت."""
    client = APIClient()

    # ۱. ثبت‌نام
    register = client.post("/api/auth/register/", {
        "username": "sara",
        "email": "sara@example.com",
        "password": "S3cret!Pass",
        "password_confirm": "S3cret!Pass",
    }, format="json")
    assert register.status_code == 201
    client.credentials(HTTP_AUTHORIZATION=f"Bearer {register.data['access']}")

    # ۲. ساخت داده اولیه (admin)
    admin = User.objects.create_user(
        username="admin", password="Admin123!", is_staff=True,
    )
    author = Author.objects.create(full_name="Test Author")
    book = Book.objects.create(
        title="Test Book", author=author,
        isbn="9780000000001", price="42.50",
        published_at=date(2020, 1, 1),
        is_published=True, stock=1,
    )

    # ۳. مشاهده کتاب
    books = client.get("/api/books/")
    assert books.status_code == 200
    assert books.data["count"] == 1

    # ۴. امانت کتاب
    loan = client.post("/api/loans/", {"book": str(book.id)}, format="json")
    assert loan.status_code == 201
    book.refresh_from_db()
    assert book.stock == 0

    # ۵. بازگشت کتاب
    loan_id = loan.data["id"]
    returned = client.post(f"/api/loans/{loan_id}/return_book/", format="json")
    assert returned.status_code == 200
    book.refresh_from_db()
    assert book.stock == 1

quiz.question: چرا منطق کسب‌وکار در Service قرار می‌گیرد نه در View؟

options.text: چون قابل تست، قابل استفاده مجدد (از View، Celery، ادمین)، و View را نازک نگه می‌دارد.

quiz.question: چرا در create_loan از transaction.atomic استفاده می‌کنیم؟

options.text: چون کاهش stock و ساخت Loan باید اتمیک باشند — اگر یکی خطا داد، هر دو برگردند.

quiz.question: چرا از F() برای کاهش stock استفاده می‌کنیم؟

options.text: چون جلوگیری از race condition — عملیات در دیتابیس انجام می‌شود، نه در پایتون.
options.explanation: با ۱۰ کاربر همزمان، بدون F() ممکن است stock اشتباه شود.

quiz.question: چرا در verify_payment از transaction.atomic استفاده می‌کنیم؟

options.text: چون ساخت Subscription و به‌روزرسانی Payment و Profile باید اتمیک باشند.
options.explanation: اگر یکی خطا داد، همه برگردند.

quiz.question: چرا در check_overdue_loans از Celery Beat استفاده می‌کنیم؟

options.text: چون باید روزانه (یا هر بازه) بررسی شود که کدام امانت‌ها دیرکرد دارند.
